story: You followed a link, or someone mentioned the site, and you have a few minutes. This is the newsroom as its editors would hand it to anyone: what leads today and why, the six desks with their newest pieces, and a short path through the ideas the rest of the site builds on. If one of the doors fits you better, take it; the page will be the same shape, filled for you.
note: If you read one thing, read the lead: it measures an argument the site makes everywhere else. If you have half an hour, take the path below in order. It starts with agents as insiders, shows one agent built three ways, then the system that runs this newsroom, and ends with the two tools most articles use as evidence.
